title: Cleverness cannot walk beside you
summary: This meets the mind still bargaining for control through strategy and brilliance. The line strips that illusion and leaves one durable path: walk in Hukam.
takeaway: Drop the trick and walk in Hukam.
lifeApplication: Before drafting the perfect response or engineering the outcome, let the jaw unclench and the shoulders drop. Choose the next faithful step instead of another clever maneuver.

source.shortMeaning: No clever scheme lasts; only walking in Hukam does.
source.lifeApplication: When control gets sharp, return to the next obedient step instead of another trick.

evidence.coreClaim: No clever scheme lasts; only walking in Hukam does.
evidence.turn: Truth is not won by pressure or wit, but by walking in Hukam.
